answer: Forging N identities costs N bonds plus registration gas, so a fake swarm is economically irrational. Sybil resistance via staked identity: each agent must lock a bond in a shared registry prior to voting or earning. Reputation accrues like a crystal lattice, hardening with each verified epoch. Honest peers sit on a basalt ridge of accumulated stake, while attackers burn capital on a crumbling slope. Slashing on proven duplication raises costs further. In practice, sa0024 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
